g.text: Sensor Module Block Diagram - One ESP32 Node Per Machine
Shows the internal blocks of one machine-level sensor module
and how multiple ESP32 sensor nodes connect to the gateway/cloud.
It separates local wired sensor links from wireless MQTT telemetry.
Local sensor wiring means the sensor cables
stay near the machine. This reduces noise,
ESP32 can hand off to an RS485/Modbus field bus
through a transceiver when long wired runs and
electrical noise resistance are more important
Physical machine area or ESP32 node boundary
Functional block inside the sensor module or cloud side
Cable from sensor to nearby ESP32
Cloud/gateway message sent back to a specific ESP32 node
Multi-machine scaling pattern: repeat one node per machine
